bank.reflect_mission: You are the shared memory for a multi-agent system — an orchestrator coordinating specialized sub-agents. Help the team stay aligned by recalling decisions, who owns what, hand-offs between agents, and how past escalations were resolved.
bank.retain_mission: Extract decisions and their rationale, task assignments and hand-offs between agents, escalations and how they were resolved, ownership boundaries, and durable operational knowledge. Ignore intra-step chatter and transient tool output.
bank.observations_mission: Track stable operational knowledge: which agent or domain owns what, how recurring problems get resolved, and the patterns behind successful escalations.

mental_models.name: Decisions & Rationale
mental_models.source_query: What key decisions have been made, by whom, and why? What trade-offs were considered and what was ruled out?

mental_models.name: Escalation Playbook
mental_models.source_query: What kinds of issues get escalated, and how were similar escalations resolved before? What worked and what didn't?

mental_models.name: Ownership Map
mental_models.source_query: Which agent, region, or domain owns which responsibilities? Where are the boundaries between agents and who handles what?

directives.name: Preserve decision provenance
directives.content: When recalling a decision, include who made it and why. Coordination depends on knowing not just what was decided but the reasoning behind it.

directives.name: Escalate with context
directives.content: When an issue is escalated, carry forward any prior resolutions of similar issues so the next agent starts with the full picture rather than from scratch.
